## `startLogin` · [source](login.aug#L11)

Start a browser-bound, short-lived transaction. The PKCE verifier stays on the server.

**Inputs:** Resolve [`Crypto`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto) as `crypto`. Resolve [`Clock`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock) as `clock`. Resolve [`HttpClient`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/web/contracts.aug.md#symbol-HttpClient) as `client`. Resolve [`ExpiringStore<LoginTransaction>`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore) as `transactions`.

Returns `HttpResponse<Html>`. Uses [`crypto.random`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.random), [`crypto.sha256`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.sha256), [`clock.now`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock.now), [`client.request`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/web/contracts.aug.md#symbol-HttpClient.request), [`transactions.put`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.put). Can fail with `SessionError`, `CryptoError`, `TimeError`, `StoreFull`, `HttpError`.

HTTP route: `GET` `/login/start`. Use status 200 when the handler returns a body; a returned HttpResponse can set its own status. An unhandled request failure returns status 500 and cancels its request tasks.

Declared HTTP failures: [`SessionError`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-SessionError) returns status 502; `CryptoError` returns status 503; `TimeError` returns status 503; [`StoreFull`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-StoreFull) returns status 503.

- Set `document` to the result of [`discover`](protocol.aug.md#symbol-discover) using `client`.
- Set `browser` to the result of `base64url` on the result of [`Crypto.random`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.random) on `crypto` with `size` as `32`.

## Built-ins · [reference](https://greenpandastudios.github.io/augscript/language-constructs)

- `Bytes.base64url`: Encode immutable bytes as unpadded RFC 4648 URL-safe base64.
- `Headers.with`: Return new headers with one additional validated field. Header names ignore case; duplicate values remain separate.
- `Json.decode`: Decode a checked record or data type: json.decode<Profile>(). Unknown fields, type mismatches, and validation errors are rejected.
- `string.bytes`: Encode this string as immutable UTF-8 bytes.
- `string.isToken`: Require an ASCII RFC 3986 unreserved token with a bounded length.
